mapper.sql: product_code AS productCode, product_version AS productVersion, product_name_zh_tw AS productName, product_type_code AS productTypeCode, CASE product_type_code WHEN 'I' THEN '投資型保險' ELSE '傳統型壽險' END AS productTypeDescription, coverage_item_type AS coverageItemType, currency_code AS currencyCode, minimum_entry_age AS minimumEntryAge, maximum_entry_age AS maximumEntryAge, minimum_sum_assured AS minimumSumAssured, maximum_sum_assured AS maximumSumAssured, minimum_premium AS minimumPremium, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, CASE WHEN product_type_code = 'I' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS investmentProduct
mapper.select: SELECT FROM new_contract.insurance_product_definition WHERE product_status = 'S' AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY product_type_code, product_code, product_version

SELECT FROM new_contract.insurance_product_definition WHERE product_code = #{productCode} AND product_version = #{productVersion} AND product_status = 'S' AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE)
